about: 회계거래조회 조건 [업무](원본 코드도움 '업무검색', 2026-10-13 loginaa 실측) — 업무 '매출'을 고르면 거래유형 '매출전표 I' 전표만 남는다. 판매(QA완제품 1 × 1,000, 비고 QA회계1)를 회계반영한 전표와 현금출금 일반전표(QA회계1-업무)를 넣고 → 업무 매출: 판매 전표만 · 일반전표 없음 → 업무 일반전표: 반대 → 해제하면 둘 다. 만든 자료는 지운다.

steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const [pa,it,wh,ac]=await Promise.all(['/partners','/items','/warehouses','/accounts'].map((p)=>window.__api('GET',p)));const c=pa.body.find((x)=>x.code==='QA-CUST'),i=it.body.find((x)=>x.code==='QA-PROD'),w=wh.body.find((x)=>x.code==='QA-WH')??wh.body[0];const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');const s=(await window.__api('POST','/sales',{saleDate:ymd,partnerId:c.id,warehouseId:w.id,taxable:true,remark:'QA회계1',lines:[{itemId:i.id,quantity:1,unitPrice:1000}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('wkSale',s.id);await window.__api('POST','/accounting-reflection/reflect',{kind:'SALES',ids:[s.id]});const e=(await window.__api('GET','/journals?from='+ymd+'&to='+ymd+'&all=true')).body.rows.find((x)=>x.sourceType==='SALES'&&x.sourceId===s.id);sessionStorage.setItem('wkNo',e.entryDate.slice(2).replace(/-/g,'/')+'-'+Number(e.docNo.split('-').pop()));const j=(await window.__api('POST','/journals/cash',{entryDate:ymd,deposit:false,counterAccountId:ac.body.find((a)=>a.code==='811').id,amount:3000,description:'QA회계1-업무'})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('wkJ',j.id);return sessionStorage.getItem('wkNo')+' '+j.docNo})()
